location: D-private collection. Originally owned by a convent. Found in the same altar as Hans Hainlein alto from 1650.
literature: Private communication from the owner, May 2006.
remarks: Beatifully decorated garland, hinge. Ring in slide bow, bell bow. Flat bell stay, with eyelet, decorated with floral-leaf pattern. Hinge, pin adjacent to bell stay. Tubular slide stays.
